title: PromptPackage
description: Output of the Prompt Intelligence Engine (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7) for a single shot. Built entirely from continuity/memory context, never from a raw hand-written prompt - see PromptOptimizer. Consumed by the Render Configuration Compiler to fill RenderSpec.positive_prompt/negative_prompt (render_configuration.schema.json), keeping the engine-agnostic RenderSpec contract itself unchanged.

version.description: Incremented every time PromptVersioning regenerates this shot's prompt (e.g. after a repair).

source_context.description: What memory/continuity state this prompt was built from - the audit trail PromptOptimizer used instead of a raw text prompt.

engine_id.description: Set once a PromptTranslator plugin has translated this package for a specific engine (wan2.1, veo, runway, luma, kling, pika, ...).

translated_prompt.description: The engine-specific rendering of positive_prompt after translation, if engine_id is set.

score.description: Set by PromptScorer. Heuristic, not model-based - see docs/adr/0013 for why.
